start_message:
Hi! This is a Secret Santa bot.
Create a game or join an existing one with a code.
about_bot:
This bot runs Secret Santa games at DRE Lab.
Source code is on GitHub: [link — placeholder].
ask_game_name: Enter a game name (up to 100 characters):
ask_code: Enter the 8-character game code (Latin letters and digits):
ask_wishes: Write your gift wishes (up to 2000 characters) or skip this step.
join_session_expired: Join session expired. Enter the game code again.
code_not_found: No game found with this code. Check the code and try again.
join_already_started: You can't join: the draw has already been run.
game_archived: The game is archived. This action is unavailable.
game_not_archived: Only an archived game can be deleted.
already_joined: You are already in this game.
need_more_players: At least two participants are needed to run the draw.
already_started: The draw has already been run; you can't run it again.
game_not_started: The draw hasn't been run yet, so no recipient is assigned yet.
invalid_game_name: The name must be between 1 and 100 characters.
invalid_wishes: Wishes must be at most 2000 characters.
no_access: You don't have access to this game.
not_organizer: Only the game organizer can do this.
not_participant: You are not in this game.
internal_error: Something went wrong. Please try again a bit later.
no_games: You don't have any games yet. Create a new one or join with a code.
archive_confirmation: After archiving, you will no longer be able to join the game, change gift status, or run the draw again. Continue?
delete_confirmation: Delete the archived game? This cannot be undone.
gift_ready_success: Great! The gift has been marked as ready.
gift_already_ready: The gift is already marked as ready.
target_sent: The recipient has been sent to your private chat.
target_delivery_failed: Could not send a private message. Start a chat with the bot and try again.
game_created: Game {name} created! Code for participants: {code} Invite link: {invite_link} Open the game to see participants or run the draw.
joined_game: You have joined the game {name}! Your recipient will appear after the draw.
start_result_ok: The draw is complete! All participants received their recipient messages.
start_result_failed: The draw is complete, but private messages could not be delivered to {failed_deliveries} participants. They can open "{my_target_button}" after starting a chat with the bot.
